_provenance.note: Rules transcribed from the Water Care manual by the team. Values marked DEMO ASSUMPTION need confirming by WaterAid.

_about: Water Care ethical-check rules as data. Every value below cites the manual file it comes from (data/manual). DEMO ASSUMPTIONS are labelled. Change rules here, not in code.

standards.S1: Ethical Standard 1 (policy 0.0 s2): no funds from organisations whose activities create or uphold barriers to safe water, sanitation and hygiene, unless overwhelmingly net positive.
standards.S2: Ethical Standard 2 (policy 0.0 s2): no relationship that poses a reputational risk likely to harm the Water Care mission.

_lookback_source: Template b, question 4: 'in the last 10 years'.

questions.text: Parent company and direct subsidiaries: are there activities in arms, gambling, pornography, tobacco or extractives?
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: any 'yes' is a potential risk.

questions.text: How do they ensure business activities don't have a negative impact on community access to WASH?
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: assess whether barriers to WASH are created or upheld.

questions.text: Nature, scale and geographical extent of international operations, including supply chain.
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: operations or supply chain in low- or middle-income countries is a potential risk.

questions.text: Has the organisation been the subject of criminal or regulatory investigation in the last 10 years?
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: 'yes' must be considered a potential risk.

questions.text: Are there media or other campaigns or allegations against them (journalists, NGOs, social media)?
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: assess the campaign; minor, resolved or irrelevant ones may not be a risk.

questions.text: Anything else relevant to Water Care's mission, credibility or reputation.
questions.risk_rule: Guide 1.4: assess against the two standards.

_search_terms_source: Template b 'Key search terms' (32 terms). 'patterns' = DEMO ASSUMPTION for offline matching.
_sectors_source: Excluded: policy 0.0 s3.3 and guide 4.1. High-risk: guide 1.1. Keywords = DEMO ASSUMPTION.

entry_criteria._source: Guide 1.1 (simplified). Values in US$ per financial year.

_lmic_source: DEMO ASSUMPTION: a partial list in the spirit of World Bank low- and middle-income groups. Replace with the full official list.
_reliability_source: DEMO ASSUMPTION, answers mentor question 'what makes a source credible?'. Confirm with WaterAid.

routing._source: Guides 1.4 and 3.2 (within one country programme / member).

low.next_step: Relationship lead confirms the desk research; the relevant decision maker signs off (template c section 3).
low.decision_maker: Team lead, manager or director (Country Director in a country programme)

medium.next_step: Request a full ethical check (guide 2.1), then decision using template e.

high.next_step: Director decides now: drop the relationship, or request a full ethical check.
high.decision_maker: Function Director or Regional Director (may escalate to the Chief Executive)

routing.escalation: Escalate if high risk, complex or contentious, or if another member or country programme flags a significant impact: Director -> Chief Executive (may seek Board input) -> Global Executive (consensus) -> Federation Board (final). High-risk decisions are reported to the Federation Board.
